content.text:
Needed: An ATX power supply with enough SATA power leads for the drives for Custom NAS from spare desktop board
Kind of part: Any item
Top price: 260 USD

request.instructions: You plan a search of second-hand listings for one needed part or device. Write 3 to 6 search phrasings a seller might have put in a listing title: the plain name, synonyms, the part or model number in the ways it gets written, the devices it is sold for, seller wording and common misspellings; each with one line on what it finds that the others miss. A phrasing is a few words for a search box that takes words, not operators or quotes. Then one match pattern: an RE2 regular expression, applied case-insensitively to a listing's text, that a listing which fits the need matches, built from the part number with optional separators or the deciding values with their units. Keep it under 200 characters; use short gaps such as .{0,20} and classes such as [-\s]?; no lookarounds, no backreferences, no comments and no inline flags. Then the words or short phrases in a listing that rule it out: for parts, broken, not working, and any that name a variant that does not fit. Never invent a part or model number the need does not give.

content.text: {"exclusions": ["broken", "not working", "dead", "for parts only", "faulty", "SFX", "TFX", "Flex", "1U", "pico PSU", "no sata cables", "missing cables"], "pattern": "atx[-\\s]?(psu|power.{0,20}supply).{0,20}sata|sata.{0,20}atx[-\\s]?(psu|power.{0,20}supply)", "phrasings": [{"text": "ATX power supply", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=ATX+power+supply", "why": "Finds standard listings using full name that abbreviated PSU searches miss."}, {"text": "ATX PSU SATA", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=ATX+PSU+SATA", "why": "Finds sellers using PSU acronym with SATA leads stated for drives."}, {"text": "desktop power supply SATA", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=desktop+power+supply+SATA", "why": "Finds desktop pulls listed by PC type rather than ATX form factor."}, {"text": "modular power supply SATA", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=modular+power+supply+SATA", "why": "Finds modular units with multiple SATA leads needed for NAS drives."}, {"text": "ATX power suply", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=ATX+power+suply", "why": "Catches common misspelling suply that correct spelling misses."}]}
